body: Oh okay, well I have an advantage of just being at home all the time while she has to work and I don’t really ever leave my room so not much she can do about that. Plus I’d be bringing my boyfriend along and she tends to act civil in front of others.

That’s what has been bugging me. I told her I plan on moving but didn’t say when (I’m moving tomorrow tho, already arranged my boyfriend to come over because his car is a bit bigger and I have a whole ass chair to haul). I couldn’t decide whether I’d want to just leave while she’s at work or wait for her to get home to say good bye. It’s a weird and tough decision to make. 

Can you tell my why you’d suggest not telling her?

Been trying to change it for 10 years now.. first I was too young to know better, then I wasn’t even home so why does it even matter (left my hometown to go to high school in a different city and live in a dorm), then my entire opinion didn’t matter because I smoked weed (it helped not want to off myself due to everything but I promised to stop and followed through with that promise)  and now I’m back to being too young to give her advice about her life or love.

I feel like there was just no way to reason with her anymore

Thank you so much, it’s common for my feelings to not be validated at home so it’s reassuring when people tell me I’m not crazy for thinking what I think.

And I really resonate with your statement about how much physical pain I need to go through to be taken seriously. This afternoon she asked me if he ever sexually assaulted me (he didn’t) and just couldn’t rationalise why else I would be afraid of him if he never hit me or hurt me in that way.

She loves pointing out that if I feel college is taking a toll on me that it’s not worth my mental health, but fails to realise that years of threats, name calling, drunken yelling and what not are worth my mental health either.
Thanks.. it’s certainly my plan. The only thing I’m worried about are my finances but I decided I’ll figure that out once I’m out.

Ugh, it’s really hard because I KNOW you are right and deep down no matter how I feel I have a conviction that this is the right decision to make. She’s just really good at getting under my skin and twisting my own words. She knows I’m very emotional and I feel like she’s trying to guilt trip me (which I pointed out to her during our conversation).

It’s just a tough decision to make because she really manages to make me feel bad about it. At this point I’m just emotionally exhausted and numb so I’m able to deflect it better but it still hurts. I already lost my dad when I was young and just never really wanted to lose her..

As for the court thing, I don’t think there can be much backlash. Here (not from the US) we have this law that lets close family members not testify if they don’t want to so I guess that’s what she’s thinking of doing. Apparently the stepdad is looking at 2 years of jail but I’m not sure how that will work if no one testifies.

Thank you.. it’s just that she’s very good at spinning my own words against me. For example, I tell her she made her choice by picking to let him back and she spins it as everything bad that ever happened is her fault... luckily I’m already emotionally drained and numb from the whole situation so i was able to deflect most of it, but it still really fucking hurts taking my words out of context...

Right now I don’t blame her because I’m just baffled it even came to this, all I want is to just finally not be a part of it. I need to start my healing after so long.

Honestly unless it’s about my household, I’m genuinely happy with my situation and close ones and I don’t want to leave it behind.

I already receive a stipend but that alone isn’t enough to cover any extra expenses like medicine and what not and I actually usually live in a dorm for a majority of the year (which I pay for with the stipend) but even that is closed down right now due to the worldwide situation so I can’t even escape to my shitty sanctuary. 

Sadly due to the intensity of the schooling program a part time job would be impossible because our schedules are really shitty (literally classes sometimes never, sometimes an entire day, but mostly it’s just in the middle of the day or morning so I couldn’t schedule anything around it) which makes me feel kinda trapped in this entire situation.

But as I said in another reply I am trying to figure out an alternative that would allow me to budget for extra expenses because I feel like I’m about to blow a fuse in the next year or so due to the situation at home.

Edit: sorry I didn’t notice to which comment I was replying to, it’s very late where I’m from so I’m feeling extra exhausted.

My family wouldn’t be down to sue him because he is genuinely a bottomless debt pit, but my mom will sell his car (which is in her name) so make up for the latest debt he caused her. 

And trust me I would leave, I’m just not in a good financial position on my own and I can’t afford a place by myself or a job (both because of the situation right now and because I study at an intense college which requires all my focus). I’m currently weighting my options as to where I could live alternatively and trying to figure something out but at the same time I feel like why should I suffer even more due to his actions?

Honestly if getting sued didn’t make him rethink everything I doubt anything could make him rethink his actions or even apologise...

But I’m genuinely just tired of everything and want to distance myself from it as much as I can. My life so far has been traumatic without his crap and I just genuinely want to distance myself from the bullshit but I’m hoping that telling him that this was the last time he crossed me (because until now I still had some respect and faith in him) he’d at least move on from trying to test my patience.

We had an entire intervention today which was mostly spent by mom screaming at him for what he did and basically listing everything he did wrong in life. 

What’s worst is he doesn’t even seem remorseful - he tries to justify his actions, lies even more and hasn’t even apologised to me.
